items.claim: Commercial-design-win momentum is broadening faster than disclosed scaled production economics are becoming visible.

finding: The newest evidence adds SEC-backed liquidity, loss, financing, scale/cost execution, and dilution-risk support, but does not provide committed production volumes, unit economics, gross-margin economics, or material recurring production economics. It therefore does not change the factual basis of the Resolver-owned contradiction.
reason: No newer source-addressed evidence resolves the missing scaled-production economics. The prior Resolver scope is not re-litigated; this run tests only the newly added evidence and preserves the gate pending genuinely new production-economics evidence.
changedStrategy: Tested only the post-adjudication SEC-backed evidence for the exact missing production-economics facts instead of repeating issuer design-win/roadmap review.
authorityBoundary: No canonical methodology, score, rank, tick, membership, or Earth Core decision is modified.
